backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the devotional app backend, defining data types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, Shloka, Temple, CommunityPost, Jap counters, Katha, etc.) and managing state maps for user profiles, temples, community posts, jap counters, dharma quotes, and kathayen with access-control and user-approval mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features for the Jap section, including bug fixes for state management and double-counting, optimistic local state updates with debounced backend sync, and a saffron/gold circular or linear progress bar for the 108-bead mala cycle.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each file's role, covering pages, hooks, components, styles, and configuration across the React frontend.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key (stored client-side in localStorage) and noting that image generation uses Pollinations.ai with no key required.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and destructive color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, Aarti, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Presentational card component for an aarti item that renders an emoji icon, name, and links to the aarti detail page using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared application shell providing a sticky header with logo and login button, bottom navigation, footer, profile setup modal for new users, and an in-app notification banner driven by the `useDailyNotifications` hook.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with 8 items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Aarti, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile) using TanStack Router for navigation and highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Displays a single chat message bubble for user or AI assistant, with TTS controls (play/pause/stop) via the useSpeechNarration hook and Hindi text detection.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Shows an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI guru avatar, used to indicate the assistant is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with a fallback Bhagavad Gita verse, showing a skeleton loader while fetching.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Displays a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates within the next 7 days, with session-storage-based per-day dismissal.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Shows a countdown card for the next upcoming Hindu festival fetched via useGetFestivals, and allows downloading a generated festival countdown image via Canvas.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders decorative floating lotus petal images as a fixed background layer with CSS keyframe animations at various positions and timings.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing golden radial-gradient halo effect around its children, with configurable size presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for a katha (religious story) showing its title, category badge, deity with emoji, text preview, and tags, linking to the katha detail page.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional text as a loading indicator, supporting three size variants.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout using the useInternetIdentity hook, showing appropriate icons and loading state.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Full-screen animated overlay that appears when 108 japa counts are completed, showing a lotus image, petal burst particles, and a celebratory message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Canvas-based animated mala (prayer bead ring) that visually fills 108 beads based on a count prop, with a slowly rotating ring and breathing Om symbol at the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Fixed top banner for displaying daily spiritual reminders (namjap, aarti, vrat) with type-specific styling, auto-dismiss timer, and a shrinking progress bar.
Short-lived animation component that bursts three Om symbols outward in different directions when rendered, disappearing after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time users to enter their name and create a profile, saving it via the useSetUserProfile mutation with loading and error feedback.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations centered on the component whenever the trigger prop changes, used as a tap feedback effect.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Hindu shloka card with Sanskrit text, Hindi and English meanings, and provides copy, share, and canvas-based image download functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component for Vrat (fasting) mode that shows Brahma Muhurat times, countdown timers to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and fasting trackers.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle UI component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, displaying a switch with contextual icons and Hindi labels indicating the mode's active state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and returns an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom React hook managing AI chat state, including sending messages, building conversation history, persisting chat to localStorage, and handling loading/error/retry states.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: A custom hook that schedules seven daily browser notifications (or in-app banners) at fixed hours for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with enable/disable and permission management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profile, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, and community posts. Wraps queries and mutations with cache invalidation using tanstack/react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom React hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with play/pause/stop controls and smart voice selection for both Hindi (Devanagari) and English content.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts (Inter and Noto Sans Devanagari), defines light/dark CSS custom properties using OKLCH colors, and declares custom keyframe animations for the jap counter and UI elements.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: AI engine module that sends chat messages to the Pollinations.ai free API using a Hindu spiritual guide system prompt, with multiple fallback strategies (POST, GET, and alternate model) and retry logic.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Static data file defining the 12 Hindu zodiac signs (rashis) with metadata and providing templated daily prediction strings for love and career aspects used by the AI Guru horoscope feature.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Static dataset of Hindu religious stories (kathas) including full Hindi texts for Ramayan and Mahabharat, typed with backend Katha/KathaCategory/KathaApprovalStatus types and pre-marked as approved.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Client-side astronomical calculation engine implementing Jean Meeus algorithms to compute Hindu calendar (Panchang) data including sun/moon longitudes, Julian day conversion, and related celestial positions for Central India (IST).
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data arrays for Shlokas and Aartis (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, etc.), each containing bilingual (Hindi/English) text content and display metadata.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: Aarti collection listing page that renders a grid of aarti cards sourced from staticData, each linking to its detail page with decorative styling and a hero banner.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti that displays its full Hindi or English text with a language toggle, and provides copy-to-clipboard and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that allows authenticated admins to manage user approvals, assign roles, and add Dharma quotes, with login and access-control guards for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: AI spiritual chat page ('Divya Guru') featuring a message thread UI with suggested prompts, typing indicator, clear-history confirmation, and keyboard-friendly textarea input backed by the useAIChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page displaying spiritual posts from the backend (with static seed posts as fallback), supporting creating, liking, and reporting posts with approval-gated posting.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated user dashboard that redirects unauthenticated users to home and shows a profile setup modal if no profile exists yet.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page displaying a hero banner, daily Panchang strip, today's shloka, a Dharma quote, and navigation teasers for Aarti and other app sections.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) counter page with a circular mala progress ring, mantra selection, local storage persistence, and optional backend sync for jap stats.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Katha (religious story) that fetches content from the backend with a static fallback, supports Hindi/English toggle, and offers text-to-speech narration.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Displays a filterable, searchable list of Hindu kathas (stories) by merging backend-fetched and static fallback data, with tab filters for category/deity and a search input.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Renders a temple-finder page with a GPS-based Google Maps link, a sacred portal link with golden ripple animation, and a static list of notable temples.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Shows a day-navigable Hindu Panchang (almanac) page displaying tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara, auspicious muhurats, and inauspicious periods computed from a panchang engine.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page supporting Internet Identity login/logout, mantra selection, jap stats display, vrat mode toggle, and daily notification permission management.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Divya Sadhana app, extending the theme with devotional color palettes (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts (Yatra One, Poppins, Tiro Devanagari Hindi), border radii, box shadows, and background images.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for the Divya Sadhana spiritual app, documenting existing features, known bugs in the Jap section (nam jap counting issues), and two pending feature requests: fixing counting bugs and adding a 108-bead progress bar.
